basics.name: Emerson Quijada Rafael
basics.label: Full Stack Developer · Java & Spring Boot · Angular | Production Systems
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer and Technical Degree holder with solid experience designing and deploying business management systems (ERP/POS) in production for real-world environments. Specialized in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot 3.x, Java 21) and modern frontends with Angular 19 (Signals). Expert in solving complex business problems through Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, and offline-first solutions (Service Workers/IndexedDB) for high-transaction environments. Focused on delivering robust, scalable software oriented toward business results.

work.name: Importaciones DENRAF
work.summary: Production ERP (Vercel + Digital Ocean) for a real import and retail business operating at trade fairs. Evolved from a pure Angular application into a complete Full Stack architecture with Angular 19, Spring Boot 3.5 / Java 21, PostgreSQL, and Docker Compose. Includes 10+ modules: POS, sales history, clients, inventory with financial intelligence, dashboard, reports with Excel/PDF export, gamified vendor goals, smart notification system, multi-currency (PEN/USD), QR payments, and business settings.
highlights: Designed a Financial Intelligence engine that classifies inventory by health (Active, Slow, and Frozen Capital) and generates automatic liquidation plans to optimize cash flow.
Implemented a Smart Notification Center that generates real-time alerts regarding sales trends, critical stock levels, and billing milestones.
Architected the solution using Hexagonal Architecture and DDD, ensuring total decoupling between business logic (Use Cases) and infrastructure (Spring Boot, PostgreSQL).
Developed an advanced Enterprise Configuration module with support for multi-currency (PEN/USD), tax profile management (RUC/NIT), and ticket customization.
Implemented offline-first architecture with IndexedDB and Service Workers, guaranteeing 100% operational availability in zero-connectivity environments.
Migrated the frontend stack to Angular 19 (Signals) and automated deployment with Docker Compose on Digital Ocean, improving operational efficiency by 40%.

work.name: Calzados La Peruanita
work.summary: Production sales and inventory system for a footwear store. End-to-end design and implementation with Angular, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL, enabling the store to digitize its invoicing, stock control, and logistics.
highlights: Designed the relational data model in PostgreSQL for hierarchical and scalable inventory management (product → color → size).
Developed secure RESTful APIs with Spring Boot to orchestrate invoicing, order management, and operational reporting.
Built a reactive and modular UI in Angular, optimizing the administrator's workflows for stock and sales control.
Automated the Full Stack ecosystem deployment across multiple cloud environments (Render for backend, Vercel for frontend).
